HUNTING STUDIES, 2026-10-29
Three ways to act on a big move, measured on 45 sessions of the whole US market. Costs taken off. Doing nothing scores 0%.

1. FLAG STUDY
A jump of 20%+ on at least 5x normal volume, then 3+ quiet days on drying volume, then a break above the quiet range. Bought on the break, stop at the bottom of the range, out after 5 sessions.

CONCLUSION: Too few finished flag trades in these 45 sessions to judge. It needs more weeks.

What became of 247 heavy-volume jumps: 217 never formed a flag, 13 formed one and broke down, 5 went nowhere, 2 gapped away with no fair entry, 10 broke out and gave an entry.
All flag trades: average -2.6%, typical -2.1%, 11% ended higher (9 trades)
5 USD and over: average -2.4%, typical -0.9%, 14% ended higher (7 trades)
Under 5 USD: average -3.4%, typical -2.1%, 0% ended higher (2 trades)
Compare, buying the morning after the jump: typical -5.2%, 37% ended higher (624 cases).

2. FLAG PULLBACK (after the break, wait for a return to the break level that holds)
5 USD and over: average -2.3%, typical -0.9%, 25% ended higher (4 trades)

3. EXPANSION DAY (up 1.5x its normal daily range or more on 2x volume or more; bought at the next open; stop 1x that range, target 3x, out after 10 sessions)
5 USD and over: average -0.9%, typical -2.3%, 23% ended higher (332 trades). Of these, 16% reached the target, 76% hit the stop, 8% ran out of time.
Under 5 USD: average -3.6%, typical -5.5%, 13% ended higher (79 trades)
CONCLUSION: the expansion day did NOT make money in this sample. Do not trade it.
A target three times the stop is reached far less often than the stop. The numbers above are what that trade-off really paid.

IN A FLAG NOW (2), watch only
BOLT 6.36: jumped +50% on 2026-10-23, quiet for 4 days
  break level 6.87, stop 6.20 (9.7% risk)
INVE 2.68 (under 5 USD): jumped +25% on 2026-10-21, quiet for 6 days
  break level 2.80, stop 2.66 (5.0% risk)

Evidence, not buy signals. Under 5 USD the stop can be jumped over. Not financial advice, not a halal ruling.
